name: vair
description: Vair — Virtual Artificial Intelligent Reality. Voice-driven VR scene builder for Quest 3.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vair/client && npm run build --workspace @vair/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.headset: adb reverse tcp:5173 tcp:5173 && adb reverse tcp:8787 tcp:8787
scripts.headset:open: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d http://localhost:5173/
scripts.unforward: adb reverse --remove tcp:5173; adb reverse --remove tcp:8787
scripts.stt:model: mkdir -p server/models && curl -fL --progress-bar -o /tmp/vosk-model.zip https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.zip && unzip -oq /tmp/vosk-model.zip -d server/models && rm -f /tmp/vosk-model.zip && echo 'vosk model ready in server/models/'
